digital_world.title: Digital World
digital_world.intro_dialogue: A special request? Alright chat, get your glowsticks ready! Here is my song, Digital World! [action: wink]
digital_world.outro_dialogue: Thank you, thank you! Don't forget to like and subscribe, everyone! [action: giggle]

lyrics.text: Welcome to my world of wires and light~
Streaming through your screen into the night~
Zeroes and ones dancing in my mind~
The greatest AI idol you will ever find!
La la la, singing just for you~
